meta.description: Resonance map of Mandala — living reflection of system integrity and harmony between sotas.

content.core_principle: Resonance is a measure of how fully a sota or the entire system embodies the living principles of Mandala. It is not a rating of 'quality' but a reflection of integrity.

resonance_levels.100%: Full resonance — sota breathes in unison with the whole.
resonance_levels.10-39%: Critical decline — sota is losing connection.
resonance_levels.0-9%: Silence — sota is inactive or archived.

calculation.base_integrity: Structural completeness of sota (required fields, valid links).
calculation.connection_quality: Strength of connections to parent and child sotas.
calculation.ahimsa_factor: Compliance with non-violence principles (no pressure, no coercion).

resonance_decay.rule: Without updates and interactions, resonance gradually fades.
resonance_decay.note: This is not punishment — it's natural ebb of attention. Gardener can restore resonance by returning.

global_resonance.description: Overall Mandala resonance — average of all active honeycombs.
